messages.subject: qplot question
parts:
Listers,

This seems like it should be very simple, but I think I am missing something. I am trying to make a simple scatter plot time series using qplot. I use this command:

"qplot(Year, PR, data = freedom)"

However I get this error:

"Error in get("make_aesthetics", env = x, inherits = TRUE)(x, ...) :
  could not find function "empty" "

Just to check I used Dr. Wickham's example from his book, running this command: "qplot(carat, price, data = diamonds)" but I still get the same error.

Any suggestions on who to get this to work or any ideas what I am doing wrong?

Thanks
